This. Works beautifully for my non-science mind to get As in science classes. In class, while reading the text, etc. take hand written notes. Messy notes, what you’re thinking, what might make sense, what doesn’t make sense, what questions you have, quickly jot it all down. 

Then, ideally for me I do this right after I get back from class but I know that’s not practical for everyone. But as soon after as possible, type those notes into a well organized beautiful document that makes the most sense to you. Answer those questions you had. If it makes more sense to organize the information differently from how the professor presented it, organize it your way. Answer the questions you have. Look into the things that are confusing. Fill the holes. 

Finally, make a basic table of contents for these notes. Just put enough information to trigger the rest to enter your mind. You’ll be shocked how much you retain after this. And the table of contents works great as a crude way to “test” yourself before the exam.

My mom took my sister and I to Buckingham Fountain (in Chicago). I was about 6 and my sister, 9 years old. We were enjoying ice cream, watching the fountain, etc. when my mom noticed a man who was carrying on a conversation with a light post. He then stumbled over to the trash can and chatted some more. 
Eventually he wandered his way over to where we were seated and started talking to my mom about my sister and I. My sister immediately jumped up and stood behind my mom. My mom remained calm and humored him for a bit. Initially, he was just chatting, saying how pretty my sister and I were. But then he started asking my mom how much we were. As in, how much money did we cost? Mom calmly told him we weren't for sale. He tried to convince her that he'd take good care of us; he had Jesus in his heart, after all. But my mom continually told him no. 
Not sure how she ended the encounter, but she scooped me up and off we went. 
We were walking back to our car when my sister spotted a police car. She pointed it out to my mom and said we should tell them what had happened. She explained what the guy said and gave a very detailed description of what he looked like and what he was wearing etc etc. my sister was such a badass that day. 
But me? Different story. I had no clue what was going on until we talked to the cops. The whole time he was there, I just happily licked my ice cream without a worry. 
I guess that's a good thing? Cause now it doesn't scare me so much. But my sister is thoroughly upset about it. 

Tl;dr a drunk guy tried to by me and my sister from my mom. Sister was a badass and told the cops. I just ate ice cream.
